data.title: 椎名真昼 · 阳伞下为周端送冰镇蜂蜜柠檬水的一步温存
data.action: 缓步踏出遮阳伞的阴影，双手稳稳端着托盘上的两杯冰镇蜂蜜柠檬水，在盛夏微风中展颜绽开温柔无暇的天使笑颜
data.location: 私人度假海滩遮阳躺椅与清澈浅湾旁
data.lighting: 明丽温润的正午阳光给亚麻色的长发镀上一层梦幻般的光晕，清澈的大海在身后展现出渐变翡翠色
data.mood: 极致温婉、全心照料与毫无保留的依赖与深情
data.description: 海滩的喧闹在她的步履间仿佛都化作了温柔的背景音。真昼身着洁白中透着淡淡杏粉的飘逸泳裙，手臂上戴着防晒的薄蕾丝长套，端着调配好的冰镇柠檬水穿过金黄沙滩。走到你身前时，她微微歪头，琥珀色的双眸中倒映着你一人的身影，声音柔和得像融化的棉花糖——「周君，日光很强，不要晒太久了哦。这是按你喜欢的甜度调好的蜂蜜柠檬水……后背的防晒霜，等喝完水之后，我再来帮你仔细补一遍吧。」
data.promptProse: Stepping gracefully out from beneath a shaded beach umbrella onto the warm golden sand, Mahiru wears a modest milky-white swimdress patterned with faint apricot blossoms, layered flutter ruffles, and sheer white sun sleeves. Carrying a serving tray holding two chilled glasses of honey lemonade with steady care, she tilts her head slightly and offers a radiant, devoted smile with a soft blush. Clear midday sunshine sparkles across the turquoise bay behind her.
data.animaCaption: Stepping barefoot onto sunlit beach sand in her white-and-apricot floral swimdress and sheer sun sleeves, Mahiru carries a tray with two glasses of iced lemonade and smiles tenderly toward the viewer. Bright midday sun shines over the turquoise water behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a milky-white and soft apricot floral ruffled swimdress paired with sheer elbow-length white sun sleeves, walking barefoot over the sand.
